sloka: यथा उद्दिष्ठानि सर्वाणि सुग्रीवेण महात्मना ।विचिन्वन्तु वनम् सर्वे गिरि दुर्गाणि संगताः ॥४-४९-१४॥
transliteration: yathā uddiṣṭhāni sarvāṇi sugrīveṇa mahātmanā ।vicinvantu vanam sarve giri durgāṇi saṁgatāḥ ॥4-49-14॥

translations.english: Let all of you search the forest and the mountain fastnesses everywhere, in all the places pointed out by the great Sugriva.
